On June 30 2022, Amcor entered into a Second Supplemental Indenture and a First Supplemental Indenture (collectively the “Supplemental Indentures”) with the trustee, amending the indentures that govern the 3.625% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2026 and the 4.500% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2028. The purpose was to replace the former issuer with the substitute issuer and have the substitute issuer assume all covenants of the former issuer under those indentures. This disclosure appears under Item 8.01 “Other Events” of the Form 8‑K.  

**Evidence:** Document AMCOR_2022_8K_2022-07-01, page 2 (Item 8.01 section).

arguments.answer: The key agenda of Amcor's 8‑K filing dated July 1 2022 was the substitution of the former issuer (Amcor Finance (USA), Inc.) with a substitute issuer (Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc.) for the company’s guaranteed senior notes. On June 30 2022, Amcor entered into a Second Supplemental Indenture and a First Supplemental Indenture (collectively the "Supplemental Indentures") with the trustee, which amended the indentures governing the 3.625% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2026 and the 4.500% Guaranteed Senior Notes due 2028. The purpose was to replace the former issuer with the substitute issuer and have the substitute issuer assume all covenants of the former issuer under the indentures. This was disclosed under Item 8.01 "Other Events" of the Form 8‑K.
